messages:
kai: quick check — preparing to onboard the new 34B variant. can someone confirm where the final weights landed and if the tokenizer has any oddities? planning a small smoke run later today.
jessica: weights are at s3://rdw-models/34b/v2/quant8/ — bucket has both fp16 and quant artifacts. manifest is s3://rdw-models/34b/v2/manifest.json :eyes:
dan: tokenizer note: it merges hyphenated tokens weirdly. e.g.
```
# local repro
>>> tok.encode('COVID-19 vs COVID 19')
[2821, 12, 3401]  # unexpected split vs previous models
```
so eval prompts with dates/ids might change token counts.
maria: config sanity check — make sure attention_impl + rope_scale are set. we had a runtime crash with default rope_scale on last import. recommended snippet: 
```
model_config:
  attention_impl: flash_attn
  rope:
    type: linear_scale
    base: 1.0
    max_seq: 8192
  gqa: true
  mqa: false
  sliding_window: true
  kv_cache_reset: on_rollout
```
infra-bot: mounting note: dedicated pool nodes have the new weights synced at /mnt/models/34b_v2_q8; container image uses sha: deploy-2026-03-11-6f4b.
sam: small smoke test you can run locally: 
```
runtest --model s3://rdw-models/34b/v2/quant8 --input tests/smoke/prompts.json --max-tokens 64 --attn-impl flash_attn
```
expected: stream starts within 150ms and no NaN grads. if you see NaN from attention, check rope_scale and GQA flags.
jessica: GQA is enabled in these weights (we trained with block=16). if runtime expects mqa you'll need fallback. also tokenizer vocab changed: there are 40 new special tokens (@@loc etc). update tokenizer.json in repo.
dan: quick log we saw when rope mismatch happened: 
```
E 03:12:45 runtime: attention_compute failed: inf encountered in qk_prod
E 03:12:45 runtime: fallback to naive_impl, latency spike
```
kai: thanks. who can review a tiny config validation PR? want to add CI that checks: weights path exists, tokenizer.vocab size match, rope params within expected ranges, and attn_impl is compatible with node GPU (a100 vs h100).
maria: I can take the PR — will add a lint step and warn on GQA/MQA mismatch.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 1790127200 to staging with config from branch `onboard/34b-v2`. :thumbsup:
sam: one more caveat — for sliding_window=true, make sure prefix_cache_size >= prompt_max_len else you'll see truncation. added a note to the onboarding checklist.
kai: perfect. I'll run the smoke test after jessica pushes the tokenizer.json update. leaving here for async followups. :raised_hands:
